item.title: “I can’t do anything…”: Sarfaraz Khan reflects on repeated India snub; feels lucky to be picked by CSK
item.description: Mumbai batter Sarfaraz Khan may have fallen out of favour with the national selectors, but he continues to grind in domestic cricket. Sarfaraz, who has 5,090 first-class runs to his name at an average of 65.25 in 61 matches, has represented India in six Tests so far, scoring 371 runs with the help of one hundred and three half-centuries. item.title: USA batter Aaron Jones provisionally suspended over alleged match fixing
item.description: The International Cricket Council (ICC) on Wednesday (January 28) provisionally suspended USA batter Aaron Jones over alleged fixing during the BIM10 league in Barbados back in the 2023-2024 season. item.title: IND v NZ 2026: “We wanted to see if…,” Suryakumar Yadav explains India’s decision to play 6 batters in 4th T20I
item.description: Team India went with the combination of six batters and five specialist bowlers in the penultimate T20I against New Zealand in Visakhapatnam on Wednesday (January 28). However, the move backfired as the Kiwis racked up a formidable 215/7 on the board and then bundle out the Men in Blue for just 165 in 18.4 overs to secure a thumping 50-run victory. item.title: IND v NZ 2026: “I can’t be the same as I was,” Shivam Dube reflects on his 'upgrade' journey after 15-ball fifty in 4th T20I
item.description: India may have lost the fourth T20I by 50 runs against New Zealand in Visakhapatnam on Wednesday (January 28), but Shivam Dube left a lasting impression on everyone with his explosive batting. Chasing 216 to win, the Men in Blue were reeling at 82/5 when Dube walked out to bat. The all-rounder went on to smash 65 off just 23 balls with 3 fours and 7 sixes to keep India’s hopes alive. item.title: “I was not feeling respected,” Yuvraj Singh reveals real reason behind his retirement
item.description: Yuvraj Singh is widely regarded as one of the greatest white-ball cricketers produced by India. He represented the country in 304 ODIs, scoring 8701 at an average of 36.56 with 14 centuries and 52 fifties. He was the Player-of-the-Tournament in India’s 2011 World Cup triumph. Yuvraj was equally good in T20Is, amassing 1177 runs from 58 matches. He was instrumental in India’s 2007 T20 World Cup title win as well. item.title: “Spoke to Virat about…”: R Ashwin hits back at social media troll over indirect attack accusation
item.description: Ravichandran Ashwin on Thursday (January 29) hit back at a social media troll after the latter accused the former India spinner of indirectly targeting Virat Kohli while analyzing India's third T20I win over New Zealand in Guwahati. item.title: “They don’t have guts,” Ajinkya Rahane claims Pakistan won't boycott T20 World Cup 2026
item.description: Pakistan Cricket Board (PCB) chairman Mohsin Naqvi held a meeting with Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif in Islamabad on Monday (January 26) to discuss the government's stand on T20 World Cup 2026 participation after Bangladesh’s ouster from the tournament.
